item.title: ironic IPA 镜像构建案例
item.description: ironic IPA 镜像构建案例 - 1 基础信息 类型 值 说明 构建环境 openEuler 24.03 (LTS-SP3) download Python Python 3.11.6 OS diskimage-builder 3.41.0 pip3 install ironic-python-agent-builder 7.2.0 pip3 install BaseOS IMAGE openEuler 24.03 (LTS-SP3) download ironic-python-agent stable/2025.2 source code requirements stable/2025.2 source code 环境配置 构建环境安装依赖包 openEuler 24.03 (LTS-SP3) # from https://opendev.org/openstack/diskimage-builder/raw/branch/master/bindep.txt dnf install -y binutils bzip2 util-linux dosfstools gdisk kpartx sudo curl git squashfs-tools qemu-img libguestfs policycoreutils-python-utils procps-ng yum yum-utils # other packages dnf install -y gcc make cmake net-tools rsyslog libaio* libnuma* glibc glibc-common glibc-devel* gcc-c++* libgcc* make* sysstat* telnet sg3_utils targetcli device-mapper-multipath sysfsutils fio iperf unzip nfs-utils gdisk lvm2 acpid qemu* 基础镜像下载 # 基础镜像中需要内置tar命令 wget https://dl-cdn.

item.title: ironic image and userdata
item.description: 裸金属镜像配置 镜像制作 type: whole disk image 准备 系统镜像ISO UEFI 引导 qemu-kvm环境 命名规范 区域-版本-架构-启动类型-文件系统-镜像大小: C01-AnolisOS-8.8-x86_64-UEFI-XFS-LVM-8G-IRONIC-yyymmdd.qcow2 分区规划参考 镜像大小8GB, 可按需求进行分区, 后面配合userdata使用 FS VG LV SIZE /boot - - 1 GB /boot/efi - - 600 MB / rootvg root 1 GB /usr rootvg usr 4 GB /var rootvg var 1 GB /home rootvg home 1 GB 软件安装 cloud-init qemu-guest-agent (可选) dnf install -y cloud-init qemu-guest-agent cloud-init配置文件更新 # 更新的内容 no_ssh_fingerprints: true disable_root: false ssh_pwauth: true network: config: disabled datasource_list: [OpenStack, ConfigDrive] datasource: OpenStack: metadata_urls: ['http://169.
